title: Solve Words in Context with Read, Predict, Match
description: Read the complete text, use logic and context clues to predict the missing meaning, and match that prediction to the best-supported answer choice.

questions.stimulus_html: The labels printed on the outside of the jars looked alike at first, but the batch number on each label was ______: no two jars shared a number.
questions.explanation_html: “No two jars shared a number” tells us that each number was distinct.
